coverage: Strong and weak flat objects and handles, third-process forwarding, owner roundtrip, nonzero target handles, unused union padding

Malformed offsets, unsupported FD objects and flags, unknown handles, 64-object boundary, failed encode rollback
Concurrent exporters share acquisition dependencies; local pointer delivery waits for acknowledgement; abandoned acquisition revokes only its node and releases known holds
Individual native capability revocation, queued and delivered requests, retained-message resources, shared caller/receiver wake broadcast
TF_CLEAR_BUF propagation and zeroed buffers after release
limitations: NDK Binder UAPI probe, not an unmodified libbinder service or usable servicemanager
FD/buffer-object transfer, weak promotion, one-way/nested calls, death subscriptions, priority inheritance and SELinux remain unsupported

Inherited open-file descriptions may defer endpoint closure despite rejected foreign-process operations
No direct APK or graphics claim
